title: Favorite drummers: the two Happys
summary: As a drummer Watts liked Red Happy Bolton at the Lyric Theater and Black Happy Goldston in the street.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: What about drummers in the old days? Since you played the old drums, who did you listen to then?
I used to like Happies. Which one? Well that goes back to the Lyric Theater, Roboshaw's orchestra.

Red Happy, Red Happy. Well I like Happy on the drum, but the brass band too. I think the old two Happies was my favorite. Happy was favorite for that orchestra, that pit boy in the theater, and Lil Black Happy on that street. He was a little, little son. He was a showman.
